description: What NOSTOS would pay for one game or console, in cash and in store credit, by condition (loose, CIB, box and game, new), from NOSTOS's own pricing engine. Says when NOSTOS isn't buying a line, or prices it in person at the counter, and why. An estimate, not an offer.

condition.description: Optional condition to focus the result on. 'boxgame' is Box & Game (No Manual).

name.description: Title to look up, e.g. 'Mario Kart 64'.
